The multimodal encoder

system_prompt_style.note: Released repo is video inference only; `_system_prompt(0)` / `_system_prompt(1)` selects a fixed system prompt per window index (src/cwm_h3_inference/config.py). Coding-agent prompting not released.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The multimodal encoder receives a system instruction, a clip-specific text description, and 11 proxy frames sampled at offsets
observation_format.note: Proxy video frames (images) plus structured text are the conditions to the video model; coding-agent observation format not reported.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from prose; no agent tool-call code in the released repo.

protocol_standardization.note: No protocol client anywhere in the 35-file tree; config model exposes only model/inference paths.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The result is a continuing agent-code loop. An interaction or world event first changes the current situation. The coding agent reads the maintained world state and chooses either to invoke existing code or locally modify the world program.
loop_primitives.note: Also described as event-driven state advance; no loop code released.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the coding agent focuses on sparse high-level intent, exceptions, and mechanisms that must be added or changed
